meta.title: Conditional Decision Engine, Action Triggers & Cross-Workbook Reconciliation

verdict_summary.headline: Do NOT execute an unexamined hold or panic sell today. With Realty Income's Q3 2026 cash yield compressing to 6.8% while the 10-Year Treasury climbed to 4.98%, the immediate-sell NNN arbitrage has narrowed — making a fast 30-day Confidential Audit + Conditional Blend-and-Extend vs. Targeted §1031 Decision Rule strictly optimal.
verdict_summary.primary_recommendation: Run the 5-item Confidential Pre-Flight Checklist (Lease Expiry/Options, City vs. County ULA Jurisdiction, Tax Basis/Debt, Store Sales/Guarantor, Dual BOV). Then apply the quantitative trigger matrix below.

decision_rules.trigger_condition: Remaining WALT <= 5.5 years OR Store sales < $1.5M OR Franchisee refuses renewal / corporate guaranty OR Property outside ULA (0.11%-0.56% DTT) AND BOV Cap <= 6.25%
decision_rules.recommended_path: P1: Sell via Targeted IRC §1031 Exchange
decision_rules.rationale: At <= 6.25% going-in exit cap and low transfer tax, exchanging at 6.8% (Realty Income Q3-26 benchmark) generates positive wealth & income accretion while escaping JACK credit shrinkage and the <5-yr WALT valuation cliff.

decision_rules.trigger_condition: Remaining WALT 6-9 years AND Store sales >= $1.85M AND City of LA Measure ULA applies (4.56%-6.06% DTT) AND Tenant accepts 10-15 yr Blend-and-Extend at >= 2.25% bumps or market reset
decision_rules.recommended_path: P2: Blend-and-Extend First (Then Re-price Hold vs. Sell)
decision_rules.rationale: Adding 8-10 years of WALT typically compresses cap rates by 75-125 bps—often lifting asset value +12% to +22% before any transfer tax is triggered, more than offsetting the 4.45%-5.95% ULA drag if you later exit.

decision_rules.trigger_condition: Sub-25% embedded tax gain OR Near-term estate step-up OR Land Value / TOD Rezoning (Metro D Line / SB-79 corridor) > 1.25x leased QSR value
decision_rules.recommended_path: P3 / P5: Hold Through Term or Execute TOD / Ground-Lease Pivot
decision_rules.rationale: If underlying Central LA corner land near newly opened Metro D Line stations exceeds dark-box QSR value, letting the tenant pay NNN rent through 2030-2035 acts as a paid land-bank option ahead of LA28 and redevelopment.

decision_rules.trigger_condition: No 6.5%+ quality 1031 replacement identified within 45-day window OR Owner prioritizes total real-estate exit & high tax basis exists (<= 30% embedded gain)
decision_rules.recommended_path: P4: Taxable Sale + Treasury / Diversified Index Portfolio
decision_rules.rationale: With 10Y Treasuries at 4.98% (state-tax exempt!) and 30Y at 5.35%, a low-gain owner avoids single-parcel seismic/retail risk entirely without forcing a rushed 45-day 1031 purchase.

decision_rules.trigger_condition: Insurance quote > 1.5% of value OR Parcel inside CAL FIRE Very High FHSZ / CGS Alquist-Priolo Fault / FEMA Flood Zone A without full tenant NNN coverage
decision_rules.recommended_path: P1 / P4: Accelerated Sale / Risk Transfer
decision_rules.rationale: CDI's $1B FAIR Plan assessment & post-2025 underwriting squeeze threaten unrecoverable landlord cost leakage and severe downside on tenant vacancy.
